subject: Re: Intro → Implementation lab: availability & attendee alignment
messages:
From: Jared Kim <j.kim@storix.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Pruitt <alex.pruitt@storix.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro to Redwood — May 12 demo

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We have a slot on May 12th that the product team blocked for a 60-minute introductory demo of Redwood. After chatting with Alex, we'd prefer to make this session more hands-on — basically convert the intro into an implementation-focused lab where our engineers can walk through a small integration and see tokenization/latency numbers against our data.

Would you be able to run a 90–120 minute implementation lab instead of the 60-minute demo? If so, could you share availability the week of May 17–21 and any prework we should do? Note: our CTO is traveling May 18–19 but can be available May 20 for a longer session.

Also: our legal team will want to loop in procurement later, but for now it's engineers + product (2–3 people).

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Kim
Director, Platform Engineering
Storix Health

Attachment(s): none referenced in this initial note
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Kim <j.kim@storix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro to Redwood — May 12 demo

Jared — thanks for the context and the preference to move to a hands-on lab. We can absolutely do an implementation-focused session; that actually helps us make the time more actionable. Couple of quick notes and asks so we can scope it correctly: 

- Recommended length: 90 minutes (compact) up to 2 hours (deep hands-on). If CTO availability is limited, we can run two split 90-minute sessions across two half-days and leave homework in between.
- Suggested attendees from Storix: 1 engineering lead, 1 engineer who will own the integration, 1 product manager (total 2–3).
- Prework: a) one sample JSON payload, b) a short example of the inference pattern you care about (latency-sensitive vs batch), c) a dev account (read-only API key) if you want us to demo end-to-end during the lab.

Availability (PDT) for Redwood: 
- Tue May 18: 09:00–12:00 or 14:00–17:00
- Thu May 20: 11:00–16:00 (we can accommodate the 2-hour block)

I attached a short proposed agenda and a prework checklist for you to review. If you prefer the split-session approach, we can deliver the agenda as: (1) architecture & core integration patterns, (2) hands-on POC scoping + guided notebook.

If May 20 works for the CTO, let's tentatively pencil that in and I'll coordinate invites. Marissa — including you in case we need to discuss pricing/terms after the lab.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment(s): redwood-impl-agenda-20270520.pdf (PDF), prework-checklist-20270520.md (text)

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful. Quick update from our side: the CTO's travel window is firm (May 18–19). May 20 is available but they only have a 90-minute contiguous slot at 13:30–15:00 PDT. Is there a way to compress the material into 90 minutes and still get hands-on value? Alternatively, we could do two 60–75 minute sessions (May 20 morning for the architecture deep dive; May 21 afternoon for hands-on), but that adds coordination overhead on our side.

Also, small ask: can you remove any high-level sales/overview content and focus the lab exclusively on integration touchpoints (auth, batching, caching, example kernels)? Our lead engineer wants to see a quick walk-through of the SDK + a guided notebook walk-through.

We can provide a read-only API key and a sanitized sample payload by EOD Tuesday. If you confirm 13:30–15:00 PDT on May 20, we'll lock that on our calendar.

—Jared

Agenda (90 min):
- 13:30–13:40: Quick introductions & success criteria (5–10 min)
- 13:40–14:05: Architecture deep dive — auth, batching, caching, kernel selection (25 min)
- 14:05–14:40: Guided notebook walkthrough (40 min) — we will run through a minimal end-to-end flow using your sanitized payload and the read-only API key you provide
- 14:40–15:00: Scoping & next steps (20 min) — checklist for POC, suggested milestone-based ark, and immediate action items

Who from Redwood: Soojin (lead engineer session), Vivek (backup and follow-ups), Marissa (commercial/contract touchpoint).

- Share sanitized payload + sample schema (Jared) — due EOD Tue May 4
